portals.name: Naukri — profile-based apply
portals.intro: Naukri applies mostly with one click using the profile resume. What matters is the profile itself: recruiters search Naukri's database by key skills and recency.

fields.tip: Upload the master ATS Word CV once; replace it only when the master changes (not per job — Naukri recruiters see the profile CV).
Mirror the CV Core Skills lines + the target role's words (talent acquisition, technical recruiter, campus hiring…). This is the search index.
'Talent Acquisition Specialist', total exp 2+ yrs — must match the CV.

tips: Naukri ranks active candidates: a small daily login + 2–3 applications keeps you 'recent'.
